definitions.explanation: A book that has been previously owned. Sold at used bookstores, flea markets, and online platforms.

examples.japanese: {古本屋|ふるほんや}で{珍|めずら}しい{本|ほん}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a rare book at a used bookstore.

examples.japanese: {教科書|きょうかしょ}は{古本|ふるほん}で{買|か}えば{安|やす}い。
examples.english: Textbooks are cheap if you buy them used.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{前|まえ}に{読|よ}まなくなった{本|ほん}を{古本屋|ふるほんや}に{売|う}った。
examples.english: Before moving, I sold books I no longer read to a used bookstore.

notes:
Japan has a rich used-book culture. {神保町|じんぼうちょう} in Tokyo is famous worldwide as a district packed with {古本屋|ふるほんや}. The chain ブックオフ (Book Off) is Japan's largest used-book retailer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古本屋|ふるほんや} (used bookstore)
- {古本|ふるほん}{市|いち} (used book fair/market)
- {古本|ふるほん}を{売|う}る (to sell used books)
- {古本|ふるほん}を{買|か}う (to buy used books)

Also read as こほん in more formal or literary contexts, but ふるほん is the everyday reading.
